name: Fukushuu Saimin ~Tsuki no Himegimi wa Fukujuu no Yume o Miru ka?~
original_name: 復讐催眠 ～月の姫君は服従の夢をみるか？～
source:
The earth is ruled by an empire and the protagonist goes to an elite school to train to be a knight of the empire. One day, the school and the town is destroyed by the goverment on behalf of the empire. The protagonist is really angry at this and decides to plot against the government. The protagonists’ parents were killed by terrorists too so he has essentially lost everything.

A girl approaches him and asks “Do you really want power? If you do, then you can achieve 'revenge'. Just tell them what to do in order to get justice.”
The mysterious girl give the potagonist the power to manipulate people with his words.
New hair, a new face, the protagonist approaches the girls who caused him so much pain – but can he really get his “revenge”?

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/15/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
translation:
地球由帝国统治，主人公在精英学校学习，以成为帝国骑士。一天，帝国政府摧毁了学校与城镇。主人公对此怒不可遏，决定策划反抗政府。他的父母也被恐怖分子杀害，因此几乎失去了一切。

一名女孩接近他，问道：「你真的想要力量吗？想要的话，就能实现『复仇』。只要告诉他们，为了获得正义该做什么。」
神秘女孩赋予主人公用言语操控他人的力量。

换上新发型、新面孔后，主人公接近那些令自己如此痛苦的女孩——但他真能完成自己的「复仇」吗？

[摘自[url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/15/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
